shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -20 && (node -v; npm -v) 2>&1

cat package.json && echo ---- && cat index.html && echo ---- && cat vite.config.ts && echo ---- && cat tsconfig.json && echo ---- && cat .gitignore && echo ---- && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo ---- && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done && echo ---- && ls node_modules | head -80 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline | head

ls node_modules/.bin | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo ----; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -iname "*ThemeProvider*" | head;

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -80; echo ----; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat styles/styles.css | head -60; echo ----; grep -o "body[^}]*}" styles/styles.css | head; echo ----; grep -o "export {[^}]*}" build/esm/components/index.js | head -c 3000; ls build/esm/components | head -100 | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -E "Button|Switch|TextInput|Checkbox|Card|Text|Label|Header|Container" components/index.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -n "href\|selected\|view\|size\|onClick" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|content" components/controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts components/controls/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find . -name "Switch.d.ts" -o -name "TextInput.d.ts" -o -name "Checkbox.d.ts" -o -name "Card.d.ts" -o -name "Text.d.ts" | head; echo ----; grep -n "view\|size" components/Card/Card.d.ts | head; grep -rn "Theme = \|RealTheme = " components/theme/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Button/Button.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ----; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; cat Card/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls Button Switch controls | head -30; grep -n "TextInput" controls/index.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; python3 -c "import playwright; print('py playwright ok')" 2>&1 | tail -1

mkdir -p /tmp/pw-check && cd /tmp/pw-check && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 300 npm i playwright@1 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3 && timeout 400 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /tmp/pw-check && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
(nohup ./node_modules/.bin/vite --port 5173 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1 > /tmp/vite.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; cat /tmp/vite.log; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:5173/

find / -name "libglib-2.0.so*" 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "exit=$?"; ls /tmp/pw-check/node_modules | head; cd /tmp/pw-check && timeout 200 npm i jsdom@25 esbuild@0.25 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -2
cd /tmp/pw-check && timeout 120 node build.mjs && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs light 2>&1 | tail -60
cd /tmp/pw-check && timeout 120 node build.mjs && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs light 2>&1 | tail -60

cd /tmp/pw-check && timeout 120 node build.mjs && echo "=== system light" && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs light 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "=== system dark" && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs dark 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /tmp/pw-check && grep -n "toggle switches\|theme saved as\|switch checked in\|root has dark\|toggle back to light" run-jsdom.mjs
cd /tmp/pw-check && echo "=== system light" && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs light 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "=== system dark" && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs dark 2>&1 | tail -30

npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -8; pkill -f "vite --port 5173" ; sleep 1; ls dist && rm -rf dist; git status --short; echo ---; git status --short --ignored | head; echo ---; wc -l src/*.ts src/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/*.css

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q "vite --port 5173"; then echo "killing ${p#/proc/}"; kill ${p#/proc/}; fi; done; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:5173/ || echo "server stopped"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:5173/ || echo "server stopped"; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short
